# EosFactory

`jaff.physics.EosFactory`

<!-- Generated by `python -m jaff._utils.api_docs`; do not edit. -->

Build the symbolic `InternalEnergy` selected by an EOS config.

Each EOS type maps to a builder method through `_BUILDERS`; the
valid types must match `EOS_TYPES`.

## Constructor

`#!python EosFactory(net, config)`

**Parameters**

**net** : _Network_
: Network supplying the symbolic densities (`ntot`, `ndens`,
    `rho`) and species list.

**config** : _EosConfig_
: The `[network.thermodynamics.eos]` config; its `type` selects the
    builder.

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`generate`](generate.md) | Build the EOS selected by `config.type`. |
| [`ideal`](ideal.md) | Volumetric ideal-gas internal energy with a single adiabatic index. |
| [`multi_gamma`](multi_gamma.md) | Internal energy summed over species with per-species adiabatic indices. |
| [`fermi_degenerate`](fermi_degenerate.md) | Non-relativistic degenerate Fermi gas EOS (not implemented). |
| [`relativistic_fermi_degenerate`](relativistic_fermi_degenerate.md) | Relativistic degenerate Fermi gas EOS (not implemented). |
